resources.string: Adds streams and channels from the public Free-TV and greektvm3u playlists, loaded from GitHub on this device when you open TV. Only used when Greece is selected. Nothing is shown if they cannot be loaded.
Shows what is on now and next for Greek channels (XMLTV guide from ext.greektv.app or epgshare01.online, refreshed at most every 6 hours). Only used when Greece is selected.
This channel comes from an optional extra source and may be less reliable
